# Shitblej

> A marketplace for buying and selling second-hand goods in Kosovo — fashion,
> electronics, collectibles and homeware. Buyers negotiate a price with the
> seller before checking out, so a listing's asking price is a starting point
> rather than a fixed cost.

The site is a single-page application. Content is rendered client-side, so an
agent that does not execute JavaScript will see an empty document; render the
page before reading it.

Prices are shown in the listing's own currency and stored in minor units
(cents) by the API, so a displayed "$120.00" is `12000` internally.

## How a purchase works

Buying is a negotiation, not a single action. The steps are enforced by the
server, so skipping one is rejected rather than silently allowed:

1. A buyer opens a listing and either makes an offer or takes the asking price.
2. The seller accepts, declines, or counters. Either side can withdraw.
3. An accepted offer reserves the item and opens a checkout window. Let the
   window lapse and the reservation is released automatically.
4. The buyer completes checkout with a delivery address, which creates the
   order.

Free-text messaging between a buyer and seller is **locked until an offer is
accepted** — before that, only offer actions can be exchanged. Messages
containing phone numbers, email addresses or social handles are rejected, so
arranging the deal off-site is not possible through the chat.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://shitblej.netlify.app/): featured listings, categories and curated collections.
- [Ladies](https://shitblej.netlify.app/collections/ladies): clothing, shoes, bags and accessories.
- [Men](https://shitblej.netlify.app/collections/men): shirts, jackets, shoes, watches.
- [Designer Items](https://shitblej.netlify.app/collections/designer-items): authenticated luxury pieces.
- [Children](https://shitblej.netlify.app/collections/children): toys, clothing, strollers, books.
- [Home](https://shitblej.netlify.app/collections/home): furniture, decor, kitchen, lighting.
- [Electronics](https://shitblej.netlify.app/collections/electronics): phones, laptops, audio, cameras, gaming.
- [Entertainment](https://shitblej.netlify.app/collections/entertainment): instruments, vinyl, books, films, games.
- [Hobby & Collector Items](https://shitblej.netlify.app/collections/hobby-collector): vintage, models, coins, art, trading cards.
- [Sport](https://shitblej.netlify.app/collections/sport): bikes, fitness, outdoor, winter gear.
- [Search](https://shitblej.netlify.app/search): full-text search across listings.

An individual listing lives at `/products/<id>`. Those pages are not listed
here or in the sitemap because they exist per listing; reach them by crawling
a collection page.

## Requires an account

These are behind authentication and redirect to sign-in otherwise. They hold
personal data and should not be indexed or scraped:

- `/sell` — create a listing
- `/inbox` — negotiations and messages
- `/profile` — the signed-in user's own listings and orders
- `/wishlist` — saved items, kept per browser for guests

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/endritbejta/shitblej): the monorepo, including the versioned REST API that serves this site. Reads are public; anything that changes data requires a token, and all endpoints are rate limited.
